timeline.summary: Weary from pursuing Sultai raiders, Surrak's party catches a group of scavengers and shambling dead under three serpent-folk, including their own lost clansfolk.
timeline.quote: The Temur spat curses as they recognized the emaciated forms of their own clansfolk, lost to hunger and disease.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Outnumbered Temur are overrun until the cave bear bursts in and rips through the Sultai ranks to Surrak's side, turning the battle.
timeline.quote: The cave bear crashed into the ranks of the Sultai, ripping apart the gaunt zombies

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in a stalemated battle Sarkhan kills the Sultai sorcerer, finds a quiet point, hears an ancient voice and a fire dragon bursts from his soul, burning everything.
timeline.quote: From my soul, a being of pure fire burst into the sky.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Taigam's golden ship arrives at Kishla, pulled by undead sibsig, to collect the town's debt for Sidisi.
timeline.quote: A human Sultai enforcer lowered the gangplank for the leaders to enter the ship and head belowdecks.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the rakshasa Ebirri offers Taigam power in the Sultai, and Taigam pledges his life to the rakshasa.
timeline.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

citation.text: "Taigam's Scheming" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Undead mastodons rise from the sand and a Sultai war party ambushes the caravan fortress.
timeline.quote: A Sultai war party!" Anafenza saw dozens of archers take positions at the parapet.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Interrogated, the captured attacker names Oret as the member of her house who hired the Sultai.
timeline.quote: Oret. It was Oret.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Without the naga's necromancy, the zombies disperse or crumble, and soldiers desert as Abzan and Jeskai raids grow.
timeline.quote: The months since had been one long slide into a perfect fulfillment of those prophetic words.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.
timeline.quote: Ikra Shidiqi, his naga advisor, betrayed him to the dragonlord Silumgar.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Mehtma learns that Sultai necromancy reached the arena district and that Jurjis controls all supply through his office.
timeline.quote: Last night, Sultai necromancy reached all the way into the arena district,

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Abzan: Siege Blossoms" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sultai artillery barrage punches through the city's ceiling, killing the clerks and wrecking the old marketplace.
timeline.quote: All three clerks were dead, one scarcely more than a smear of blood and flesh where the artillery stone had made its initial impact.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Abzan: Siege Blossoms" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sultai noble tells the Mardu engineer how a hungry Mardu boy killed her for two days of rice.
timeline.quote: He killed me for two days' worth of rice.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai begin raiding the Ukud Necropolis vaults.
timeline.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai began raiding its vaults.

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Sultai raiding party topples the rolling fortress; Anafenza and Gvar survive and flee into the desert.
timeline.quote: A pair of the mastodons toppled the entire fortress

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, Silumgar forces the naga into slavery as a result of Tasigur's pact; after his overthrow the Sultai revive.
timeline.quote: Naga were forced into becoming slaves, undead or otherwise, by Silumgar as the result of a pact Tasigur made with the dragon.

citation.text: "Naga", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A protracted siege of Qatros Karst City by the Sultai over mining rights around 4564 AR kills over a hundred Abzan.
timeline.quote: A conflict over mining rights with the Sultai Brood led to a protracted siege against the city around 4564 AR

citation.text: "Shifting Wastes", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Silumgar dies in the river Marang, killed by a young Sultai khan.
timeline.quote: Silumgar never reached elder status and died in the river Marang

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sultai fall from grace due to the actions of their human khan.
timeline.quote: The clan was originally ruled by humans , but due to the actions of their khan at the time, it fell from grace.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sultai are utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent clan.
timeline.quote: the Sultai were utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent Clan

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sultai subjects foment resistance against Silumgar, supported by dissident naga necromancy.
timeline.quote: his subjects were some of the first in Tarkir to foment resistance against their dragonlord

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Silumgar weakened and Teval's aid, the rebels defeat the dragonlord and take power.
timeline.quote: they fought and defeated the dragonlord, installing themselves in power

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Sultai reject the old cruelty and seek a new cultural identity through the counsel of ancient zombies.
timeline.quote: They found this in the counsel of the ancient zombies raised during the rebellion, who spoke of a time before the pacts with the rakshasa.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Sultai outlaw raising unwilling individuals as sibsig.
timeline.quote: The new Sultai view this practice as symbolic of the cruel and wasteful decadence of the ruling classes and have outlawed the raising of unwilling individuals.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Rite of Renewal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Through Narset's research, the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
timeline.quote: the clans were able to overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
